SYSTEM and credit constructors after the requested transaction do not alter its chosen prefix; nonnegative later credits only weaken prefixCredits<=total. When extracting a later transaction, its actual prior Trace includes all preceding SYSTEM and credit edges even though receipts.take records transaction positions only.
Equal receipt values are retained at distinct natural list indices; no Nodup or Finset quotient is introduced. Structural prefix choice and work take i distinguish positions and count multiplicity.
position_work is natural list induction showing prefix marked-event sum plus the same receipt event count<=total. It does not assume gas charge, count only successful records, or omit reverted work.

observed derives prefix Trace, admission/resources, prefix funding and prefix JournalInvariant from single outer seed and total envelopes. There is no supplied intermediate pertransaction/percall invariant. Total credits bound implies prefix cap via prefixCredits<=credits; total work bound implies prefix-plus-current bound.

The exact receipt canonical tree and its actual Cert feed TransactionJournal.observed. Located Theta retains exact arguments/fuel/result; positive-fuel local completed result is explicit and arbitrary status is allowed. Output budget is prefix work+same-tree chronological before+same local subtree count.

Total genesis+basecredits+credits funding ceiling and work bound, or exact ordered blocklist equality with typed slot uniqueness/admittedGas.
